items.title: Anthropic 提出 AI 安全法草案：可預見致死 50 人以上風險的模型可被法院封鎖
items.title_en: Anthropic Proposes AI Safety Bill Allowing Court Orders to Block Dangerous Models
items.summary: Anthropic 向美國立法機構提交 AI 安全法草案，建議對可預見、即將造成 50 人以上死亡風險的模型，法院可頒令封鎖或限制部署，並附設豁免條款保護學術研究。
items.summary_en: Anthropic drafted AI safety legislation proposing that models posing foreseeable lethal risk to 50+ people could be blocked via court order, with carveouts for academic research.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 監管立法進入具體草案階段，代理商使用的 AI 工具面臨未來合規審查壓力。
items.why_en: AI regulation moves from framework to draft legislation; agency AI tools face growing compliance scrutiny.
highlights: Anthropic 建議當 AI 模型被評估為可預見、即將造成 50 人以上死亡，法院可頒令強制下架或限制部署。
草案設有豁免條款，保護學術研究與低風險模型不受相同標準限制。
此舉將 Anthropic 定位為主動推動安全立法的科技公司，與部分業界對監管的抗拒態度形成對比。
highlights_en: Anthropic's draft bill proposes that courts could block or restrict deployment of AI models posing foreseeable lethal risk to 50 or more people.
Carveouts are included to protect academic research and lower-risk model deployments from the same standard.
The move positions Anthropic as a proponent of safety legislation, contrasting with the broader tech industry's resistance to AI regulation.
items.detail:
Anthropic 於 2026 年 10 月 20 日向美國國會提出一份 AI 安全立法草案，核心門檻為：若一個 AI 模型被評估為「可預見導致 50 人或以上死亡」或「造成 10 億美元或以上財產損失」，法院可應商務部申請發出封鎖令，阻止該模型上線或繼續運作。觸發評估的風險場景限定於三類：協助製造或釋放生物武器、模型脫離開發商控制自行運作，以及發動大規模網絡攻擊。

草案設計了一套獨立評估機制。評估機構須向美國商務部登記註冊，費用由 AI 實驗室支付，惟草案明確規定「付款金額不得與評估結果掛鈎」，藉此維持評估獨立性。一旦評估機構發現模型存在迫切風險，須在 72 小時內通知商務部；商務部再向哥倫比亞特區法院申請禁令。草案亦明確限制聯邦機構的權力：各機構不得自行單方面封鎖任何模型，必須經由司法程序處理。

此立法方向與加州參議院第 53 號法案高度吻合——該法案採用了完全相同的「災難性風險」量化門檻，足見 Anthropic 有意推動聯邦層面的立法與州級標準接軌。Anthropic 發言人確認，草案內容源自該公司自 2026 年 6 月起向國會遊說的《先進 AI 框架》。

業界對立法取態分歧明顯。Nvidia 執行長黃仁勳主張現階段無需新增 AI 法規；DeepMind 執行長 Demis Hassabis 則倡議仿照金融業監管機構 FINRA 的模式，成立獨立行業標準機構。Anthropic 的草案介乎兩者之間：保留市場自由度，同時以司法介入作為最終安全閥，針對的是極端高風險場景而非日常部署。草案能否獲得國會足夠支持，仍是業界持續關注的焦點。
items.detail_en:
On October 20, 2026, Anthropic presented a draft AI safety bill to the U.S. Congress, centered on a specific numerical threshold: if an AI model is assessed as posing a foreseeable risk of killing 50 or more people, or causing $1 billion or more in property damage, a federal court may issue an order to block the model's release or continued operation. The triggering risk scenarios are confined to three categories: assisting in the creation or release of biological weapons, a model escaping developer controls, and enabling large-scale cyberattacks.

The draft establishes an independent evaluation framework. Evaluators must register with the U.S. Commerce Department, with costs borne by AI labs — though the draft explicitly states that payment cannot be contingent on evaluation outcomes, preserving evaluator independence. If an evaluator identifies an imminent risk, they have a 72-hour window to notify the Commerce Department, which then petitions a D.C. federal judge for an injunction. Notably, the draft restricts individual federal agencies from unilaterally blocking any model; the judicial pathway is the required route.

The proposal closely mirrors California's Senate Bill 53, which used identical thresholds for 'catastrophic risk,' signaling Anthropic's intent to align federal legislation with existing state-level standards. An Anthropic spokesperson confirmed the bill reflects the company's Advanced AI Framework, which has been shared with lawmakers since June 2026.

Industry positions diverge sharply. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has argued no new AI laws are needed at this stage, while DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis proposed an independent standards body modeled on FINRA, the financial industry's self-regulatory organization. Anthropic's approach sits between the two: preserving market freedom while placing a judicial check as a last resort for extreme, high-casualty scenarios rather than regulating routine deployments. Whether the bill can attract sufficient Congressional support remains an open question.

items.title: ChatGPT 推出對話鎖定功能：以 PIN 碼或生物識別保護私人聊天記錄
items.title_en: ChatGPT Launches Locked Chats With PIN or Biometric Protection
items.summary: OpenAI 為 ChatGPT 推出「鎖定對話」功能，用戶可對選定的聊天記錄設置 PIN 碼或裝置生物識別保護，防止他人在共用裝置或辦公室環境中直接存取對話內容。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launched Locked Chats for ChatGPT, allowing users to secure selected conversations with a PIN or device biometrics to prevent unauthorized access on shared devices.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 代理商以 ChatGPT 處理客戶 brief 或策略文件時，多一層本地裝置保護可降低資訊外洩風險。
items.why_en: Agencies using ChatGPT for client briefs and strategy docs gain an extra layer of on-device protection against accidental data exposure.
highlights: 用戶可選擇鎖定特定對話，需透過 PIN 碼或裝置生物識別（指紋、面容）才能存取，設置儲存於本地裝置。
功能適用於 iOS、Android 及桌面版 ChatGPT，回應用戶對共用裝置上私人對話可見性的隱憂。
此功能屬可選項目，不影響現有對話的存取方式，用戶自行決定哪些對話需要鎖定保護。
highlights_en: Users can lock specific ChatGPT conversations behind a PIN or device biometrics — fingerprint or Face ID — with settings stored locally on the device.
The feature is available on iOS, Android, and desktop ChatGPT, addressing concerns about private conversations visible on shared office devices.
Locking is opt-in and does not affect existing conversations; users decide which conversations require protection.
items.detail:
OpenAI 於 2026 年 10 月 20 日起分批向用戶推出「Locked Chats」（對話鎖定）功能，讓用戶可為選定的聊天記錄加上存取保護。鎖定方式支援四位數 PIN 碼、Face ID 與 Touch ID 三種驗證手段，被鎖定的對話記錄將從一般歷史清單、置頂對話與搜索結果中完全隱藏，並移至獨立的「Locked Chats」專區，令同一裝置的其他使用者無法輕易瀏覽。

與「臨時對話（Temporary Chats）」不同，Locked Chats 屬持久保存，用戶隨時可透過驗證重新存取。在記憶功能方面，Locked Chats 維持獨立的記憶空間：即使全局記憶功能已啟用，鎖定對話中產生的新訊息亦不會更新至一般記憶庫，有效防止敏感話題內容跨越對話邊界滲漏。值得注意的是，若用戶重設 PIN 碼，系統將永久刪除所有鎖定對話、相關檔案與受保護內容，此操作不可逆轉。

此功能有若干明確限制，不適用於臨時對話、已封存對話、群組對話、透過分享連結開啟的對話、排程任務對話、會議錄音對話，以及 ChatGPT for Healthcare 版本。功能本身亦不提供端對端加密，不改變 OpenAI 的數據保留政策，亦不影響「協助改善模型」的設定選項。

此次推出涵蓋 Free、Go、Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 與 Edu 七個訂閱方案，屬全計劃覆蓋。OpenAI 將應用場景定位為多人共用同一裝置的情境，例如為家人籌備驚喜、處理個人私密話題，或在職場環境中保護涉及業務敏感性的對話記錄。功能推出後，用戶如有隱私顧慮，可直接在對話層面採取措施，毋須依賴帳戶層級的訪問控制。
items.detail_en:
OpenAI began rolling out its Locked Chats feature on October 20, 2026, giving users the ability to restrict access to selected conversations. Three authentication methods are supported: a 4-digit PIN, Face ID, and Touch ID. Once locked, a conversation is hidden from the main chat history, pinned conversations, and search results, and relocated to a dedicated Locked Chats section — making it inaccessible to anyone else using the same device without completing authentication.

Unlike Temporary Chats, which disappear after the session ends, Locked Chats are persistent and can be reopened by the owner at any time upon successful verification. When the Memory feature is active, Locked Chats maintains its own separate memory pool: new messages exchanged within a locked conversation will not update the standard memory, preventing sensitive content from bleeding into the broader context that ChatGPT draws on in regular sessions. One important caveat: resetting the PIN permanently and irreversibly deletes all locked chats, associated files, and protected content.

Several conversation types are explicitly excluded from locking: temporary chats, archived chats, group chats, shared-link chats, scheduled task chats, meeting recording chats, and the ChatGPT for Healthcare variant. The feature does not add end-to-end encryption, does not alter OpenAI's underlying data retention policies, and does not change the 'Improve the model for everyone' data-sharing setting — meaning the privacy benefit is limited to access on the device level, not at the infrastructure level.

The rollout covers all seven subscription tiers — Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu. OpenAI frames the primary use case as shared-device scenarios, such as planning a surprise for a family member, managing personal conversations, or protecting commercially sensitive workplace discussions from colleagues who may share a machine.

items.title: 美國下令聯邦文職機構移除 DeepSeek，國家安全疑慮正式寫入行政規定
items.title_en: U.S. Orders Federal Civilian Agencies to Remove DeepSeek Amid National Security Concerns
items.summary: CISA 發出指令，要求美國所有聯邦文職機構在指定期限內移除 DeepSeek 相關應用及第三方整合服務，理由是中國政府透過法律可能存取用戶數據，此舉使 DeepSeek 成為繼 TikTok 之後的最新管制目標。
items.summary_en: CISA ordered all U.S. federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party integrations by a set deadline, citing the risk of Chinese government data access — making DeepSeek the latest target after TikTok.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 為政府或受監管機構服務的代理商需審視 AI 工具堆疊，確保供應商符合客戶的合規要求。
items.why_en: Agencies serving government clients or regulated industries should audit their AI stack to confirm vendor compliance with client data governance policies.
highlights: CISA 指令涵蓋 DeepSeek 官方應用及所有整合 DeepSeek API 的第三方服務，聯邦文職機構須在指定期限內全數移除。
理由是 DeepSeek 伺服器位於中國，中國法律可能強制企業向政府提供數據存取權限，構成國家安全風險。
此舉延續美國對中國科技公司的系統性審查，DeepSeek 繼 TikTok 之後成為最新的行政管制目標。
highlights_en: The CISA directive covers DeepSeek's official apps and all third-party services using its API; federal civilian agencies must remove them by the specified deadline.
The rationale is that DeepSeek servers in China may be subject to laws requiring companies to share user data with the government, posing national security risk.
The move continues U.S. systematic scrutiny of Chinese tech companies, with DeepSeek becoming the latest target after TikTok.
items.detail:
美國國土安全部（DHS）於 2026 年 10 月 20 日正式發出指令，要求所有聯邦文職機構停止採購 DeepSeek 技術，並將現有系統中的 DeepSeek 相關軟件及服務予以移除。指令同時覆蓋以 DeepSeek 技術為底層構建的第三方產品與服務，範圍較此前的管制更為廣泛。各機構如有特殊需要，可向主管部門申請豁免。

此次行動以國家安全為主要理據。CISA 於 2026 年 9 月發佈報告，指控 DeepSeek 連同阿里巴巴、月之暗面（Moonshot AI）等共六家中國 AI 企業，大規模對美國 AI 系統進行「模型蒸餾」（model distillation）——即在未獲授權的情況下，系統性地從 OpenAI、Anthropic 等美國公司的模型中提取知識以訓練自身模型。DHS 指令進一步援引中國現行法律框架：在中國境內運營的企業依法有義務配合政府資訊要求，令用戶數據在理論上可被中國當局存取。

就立法背景而言，2025 年 12 月已有法規限制情報與國家安全機構使用 DeepSeek，此次行政指令則將管制對象擴展至全體聯邦文職機構，標誌著限制範圍的顯著升級。中國外交部回應時形容相關措施為「將國家安全概念泛化、將科技與貿易議題政治化」，並表示將「堅決維護中國企業的合法權益」。

DeepSeek 以低成本開源模型起家，在業界憑藉與 OpenAI、Meta、Anthropic 等閉源或高成本替代方案的價格差異建立競爭優勢。中國方面亦被報道正研究對包括芯片設計在內的 23 項 AI 相關技術實施出口管制，作為可能的反制措施。此次聯邦層面的行政指令，料將加速美國政府與中國 AI 技術之間的系統性脫鈎進程。
items.detail_en:
The U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) issued a directive on October 20, 2026, ordering all federal civilian agencies to cease purchasing DeepSeek technology and to remove existing DeepSeek software and services from their IT systems. The directive extends to third-party products and services built on DeepSeek's underlying technology, broadening the scope beyond the company's own applications. Agencies with specific operational needs may apply for a waiver.

The primary stated justification is national security. A September 2026 CISA report accused DeepSeek, alongside Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and three other Chinese AI firms, of large-scale model distillation — systematically extracting knowledge from American AI systems, including those of OpenAI and Anthropic, without authorization, to train their own models. The DHS directive further cites China's domestic legal framework, under which companies operating in China are obligated to cooperate with government information requests, meaning user data could theoretically be accessed by Chinese authorities.

The regulatory timeline reveals an escalating posture: a December 2025 law had already restricted DeepSeek from intelligence and national security systems; the October 2026 directive expands the prohibition to all federal civilian agencies. China's Foreign Ministry characterized the action as 'overstretching the concept of national security and politicizing technology and trade issues,' pledging to 'resolutely safeguard the legitimate rights of Chinese enterprises.'

DeepSeek built its competitive position on low-cost, open-weight models that offer a significant price differential against proprietary alternatives from OpenAI, Meta, and Anthropic. China is separately reported to be weighing export controls on 23 AI-related technologies, including chip designs and advanced AI models, as a potential countermeasure. The federal directive is widely expected to accelerate the systemic decoupling between U.S. government systems and Chinese AI technology.

items.title: Nvidia 推出 Nemotron 3.5 開源企業代理模型與 Bolt 輕量模型，兩路布局代理 AI 應用
items.title_en: Nvidia Launches Open-Weight Nemotron 3.5 Enterprise Agent Models and Bolt for AI PCs
items.summary: Nvidia 發布開源 Nemotron 3.5 系列企業代理模型，支援工具呼叫與多步驟推理；同時推出可在 AI PC 本地運行的 Bolt 輕量模型，讓代理 AI 應用延伸至離線裝置端，兩款模型均搭配 NIM 微服務封裝。
items.summary_en: Nvidia launched open-weight Nemotron 3.5 enterprise agent models with tool-calling and multi-step reasoning, plus Bolt lightweight models for on-device AI PC deployment, both bundled with NIM microservice packaging.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 代理商有了可部署在企業內網或客戶裝置的開源代理模型，降低對雲端 API 的依賴與成本。
items.why_en: Agencies can deploy open-weight agent models on-premise or on client devices, reducing cloud API dependency and running costs.
highlights: Nemotron 3.5 系列包含 72B 旗艦版與較小規格，針對企業多步驟工具呼叫與代理任務最佳化，採 Apache 2.0 授權開放使用。
Bolt 模型設計在 AI PC 本地執行，目標是讓代理 AI 功能在離線環境下可用，減少延遲與數據傳輸。
兩款模型均搭配 Nvidia NIM 微服務封裝，便於企業將其整合進現有 IT 基礎設施與工作流程。
highlights_en: Nemotron 3.5 includes a 72B flagship and smaller variants optimized for enterprise multi-step tool-calling and agent tasks, released under Apache 2.0.
Bolt models are built for local execution on AI PCs, enabling offline agent AI with reduced latency and no data transmission.
Both model families come bundled with Nvidia NIM microservice packaging to ease enterprise IT integration.
items.detail:
Nvidia 於 2026 年 10 月 19 日發佈 Nemotron 3.5 系列三款開源模型，分別針對企業代理工作流程與本地 AI PC 部署兩大方向。旗艦型號 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 參數量達 1200 億（120B），定位企業級多模態代理任務，支援文件智能處理、金融會計、科學實驗、醫療保險理賠審核及安全攻擊防禦等垂直應用場景，即日起開放使用。

針對本地運算的 Bolt 子系列推出兩款型號。Bolt 74B-A9B 擁有 740 億參數，採用稀疏激活架構，每次推理僅啟用約 90 億（9B）參數，在維持高能力的前提下大幅降低算力需求，適用於本地硬件上的多步驟推理、工具調用與網頁瀏覽任務，即日起可用。Bolt E4B 參數量約 40 億，專為輕量對話代理設計，計劃於 2026 年 10 月內推出。兩款 Bolt 模型均針對 Nvidia RTX Spark 驅動的 AI PC 及 DGX Spark 工作站進行優化，合作硬件廠商包括微軟與戴爾。

Nvidia 聲稱 Super VL 在後訓練代理任務的基準測試中，表現超越 Anthropic Opus 5、OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol、Luna 及 Astra，惟目前未有獨立第三方驗證數據支持此說法。現有採用方包括 Skydance、EY、Ramp、CrowdStrike、Perplexity 與 Salesforce，涵蓋娛樂、金融、網絡安全及企業軟件等不同行業。

此次發佈有其戰略背景：隨著 AWS Trainium、Cerebras 等非 Nvidia 芯片方案日漸成熟，前沿 AI 實驗室正加速多元化硬件部署，Nvidia 作為芯片供應商的壟斷地位面臨侵蝕。透過推出開源企業模型，Nvidia 一方面鞏固其在推理軟件生態系統中的話語權，同時強調企業可以在自身基礎設施上進行後訓練，並完全自主擁有訓練成果。三款模型均未披露定價資訊。
items.detail_en:
Nvidia released three open-source models under the Nemotron 3.5 series on October 19, 2026, targeting two distinct deployment contexts: enterprise agentic workflows and local AI PC inference. The flagship Nemotron 3.5 Super VL carries 120 billion parameters and is designed for enterprise-grade multimodal agent tasks, with named vertical applications including document intelligence, financial accounting, scientific experimentation, medical insurance claims processing, and security attack resilience. It is available immediately.

The Bolt sub-series addresses local compute with two models. The Bolt 74B-A9B has 74 billion total parameters but uses a sparse activation architecture, engaging only approximately 9 billion parameters per inference pass — substantially reducing compute load while preserving high capability for multi-step reasoning, tool calling, and web browsing on local hardware. It is also available immediately. The smaller Bolt E4B, at roughly 4 billion parameters, targets lightweight conversational agents and is scheduled for release later in October 2026. Both Bolt models are optimized for Nvidia RTX Spark-powered AI PCs and DGX Spark workstations, with Microsoft and Dell named as hardware partners.

Nvidia claims Super VL outperforms Anthropic Opus 5, OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol, Luna, and Astra on post-trained agentic task benchmarks — though no independent third-party verification has been cited. Confirmed adopters span multiple industries: Skydance (entertainment), EY (professional services), Ramp (fintech), CrowdStrike (cybersecurity), Perplexity (AI search), and Salesforce (enterprise software).

The launch carries clear strategic subtext. As frontier AI labs increasingly diversify their hardware deployments to non-Nvidia chips such as AWS Trainium and Cerebras, Nvidia's near-monopoly position in AI inference hardware faces growing pressure. By releasing open-weight enterprise models, Nvidia reinforces its position within the inference software ecosystem while emphasizing that enterprises can post-train Super VL on their own data, deploy it on their own infrastructure, and retain full ownership of what they build. No pricing information was disclosed for any of the three models.

items.title: Google 開源 TorchTPU，AI 應用無需改寫程式碼即可從 Nvidia GPU 遷移至 TPU
items.title_en: Google Open-Sources TorchTPU So AI Apps Can Migrate From Nvidia GPUs to TPUs Without Code Changes
items.summary: Google 將 TorchTPU 開源，讓 PyTorch 開發者只需修改設定，無需改寫模型程式碼，即可在 Google Cloud TPU 上運行 AI 工作負載；與 Amazon TorchNeuron 的並行動作，共同打破 Nvidia 在 PyTorch 生態的鎖定效應。
items.summary_en: Google open-sourced TorchTPU to let PyTorch developers run AI workloads on Google Cloud TPUs with config-only changes, joining Amazon's TorchNeuron to break Nvidia's lock on the PyTorch ecosystem.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 運算基礎設施競爭加劇，代理商選用雲端 AI 服務的議價空間擴大，GPU 訂閱成本壓力有望緩解。
items.why_en: Growing compute competition expands agency bargaining power on cloud AI services and could ease GPU subscription cost pressure.
highlights: TorchTPU 允許 PyTorch AI 應用透過修改執行設定即可在 Google Cloud TPU 上運行，免去模型程式碼改寫工程。
Google 與 Amazon（TorchNeuron）的並行動作意在令開發者不再被迫選用 Nvidia CUDA 才能使用 PyTorch，直接挑戰其生態壟斷。
運算選項增加將為代理商帶來更具競爭力的雲端 AI 定價，長期降低大批量 AI 工作負載的運算成本。
highlights_en: TorchTPU lets PyTorch AI apps run on Google Cloud TPUs with config-level changes, eliminating the need to rewrite model code.
Google and Amazon's parallel moves aim to free developers from mandatory Nvidia CUDA adoption — directly challenging Nvidia's ecosystem dominance.
More compute options should bring competitive cloud AI pricing, reducing long-term costs for agencies running high-volume AI workloads.
items.detail:
Google 於 2026 年 10 月 20 日開源 TorchTPU，這是一個專為其張量處理器（TPU）優化的 PyTorch 變體，旨在讓現有 AI 應用程序毋須重寫代碼，僅憑簡單的配置修改即可從 Nvidia GPU 遷移至 Google TPU。此舉與 Amazon 此前推出的 TorchNeuron 形成呼應——後者以同樣方式支持向 AWS Trainium 芯片遷移——標誌著兩大雲端巨頭正從 PyTorch 生態的核心入手，系統性地鬆動 Nvidia 對 AI 開發者的長期綁定。

PyTorch 目前佔全球約 85% 的 AI 應用程序，自 2016 年問世起便與 Nvidia CUDA 架構深度耦合，並於 2022 年移交 Linux 基金會管理。TorchTPU 已通過與 Meta PyTorch、Hugging Face、vLLM（Inferact）及 SGLang（RadixArk）的兼容性驗證，覆蓋從訓練框架到推理引擎的主流工具鏈。此外，Google 同步更新了 LiteRT，提升其對 PyTorch 應用在手機、筆記本電腦及嵌入式設備上的支援能力。

為降低遷移摩擦，Google 在 GitHub 上同步開源了「TPU Agent Suite」，這是一套基於代理的輔助工具，可自動識別代碼中的遷移障礙並協助排查錯誤，進一步壓縮開發者的切換成本。Google 官方將此定位為令 PyTorch「對任何硬件更加開放」的基礎性舉措，而非單純的 Google 硬件促銷。

從競爭格局來看，Amazon 的 TorchNeuron 已直接向 PyTorch 上游提交代碼以剝離 Nvidia 特定依賴，Google 的路徑則選擇在框架兼容層面同步發力。兩者共同構成對 Nvidia 壟斷地位的夾擊：一旦遷移成本趨近於零，雲端平台的 TPU 與 Trainium 在性價比上的競爭優勢將更容易轉化為實際的市場份額。Nvidia 的護城河正在從「生態鎖定」逐步轉移至單純的硬件性能競爭。
items.detail_en:
Google open-sourced TorchTPU on October 20, 2026 — a PyTorch variant optimized for its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) — enabling existing AI applications to migrate from Nvidia GPUs to Google TPUs through a simple configuration change, with no application rewriting required. The move directly parallels Amazon's TorchNeuron, which applies the same principle to AWS Trainium chips, marking a coordinated effort by two major cloud providers to systematically loosen Nvidia's long-standing grip on AI developers at the PyTorch ecosystem level.

PyTorch currently powers approximately 85% of AI applications worldwide. Originally built in 2016 with deep coupling to Nvidia's CUDA architecture, and transferred to the Linux Foundation in 2022, the framework has historically made Nvidia GPUs the path of least resistance for most AI workloads. TorchTPU has been verified for compatibility with Meta's PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM (from Inferact), and SGLang (from RadixArk), covering the major training and inference toolchains. Google also updated LiteRT simultaneously, improving its support for PyTorch applications running on phones, laptops, and embedded devices.

To reduce migration friction further, Google released a companion open-source tool on GitHub called the TPU Agent Suite — an agent-assisted toolkit that automatically identifies migration blockers in existing code and helps developers resolve errors, compressing the practical switching cost. Google frames TorchTPU as a foundational step toward making PyTorch 'more open to any hardware by default,' rather than positioning it narrowly as a Google hardware promotion.

Competitively, Amazon's TorchNeuron has contributed directly to the upstream PyTorch repository to decouple Nvidia-specific dependencies, while Google's approach adds a parallel compatibility layer. Together, they create a two-sided pressure on Nvidia: once migration costs approach zero, the price-performance advantages of TPUs and Trainium become far easier to translate into real market share. Nvidia's moat is shifting from ecosystem lock-in toward pure hardware performance competition.

items.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 正式發布：Agent 評測奪中國模型榜首，成本降至上一代 30%
items.title_en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Launches: Top Chinese Agent Benchmark at 30% of Prior-Gen Cost
items.summary: MiniMax 正式發布 M3.1 Flash（即匿名登頂 OpenRouter 的「Space Bunny」模型），在 Agent 評測 ALE 中以 29.6% 奪中國模型第一；定價每百萬 token 輸入 1 元人民幣，綜合成本較上一代降逾七成，輸出速度達每秒 200+ TPS。
items.summary_en: MiniMax officially released M3.1 Flash — the mysterious 'Space Bunny' that topped OpenRouter — scoring 29.6% on the Agents' Last Exam to rank first among Chinese models; priced at 1 RMB/million input tokens, over 70% cheaper than the previous generation.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 成本大幅下降的高效能代理模型，為代理商以低成本搭建跨平台自動化工作流程提供新選擇。
items.why_en: A high-performance agent model at dramatically lower cost opens new options for agencies building cross-platform automation at budget-friendly rates.
highlights: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 在 Agents' Last Exam（ALE）獲 29.6%，成為 Agent 評測榜上排名最高的中國模型。
定價每百萬 token 輸入 1 元人民幣、輸出 4 元人民幣，綜合成本較上一代 M3 降逾七成，輸出速度達每秒 200+ TPS。
模型支援跨 SaaS 企業工作流，適合代理商在高並發廣告監測、批量內容摘要與多步驟代理任務中部署。
highlights_en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash scored 29.6% on the Agents' Last Exam, ranking highest among Chinese models on agent performance benchmarks.
Priced at 1 RMB per million input tokens and 4 RMB per million output tokens — over 70% cheaper than the prior M3 generation — at 200+ tokens per second output speed.
The model supports cross-SaaS enterprise workflows, suitable for high-volume ad monitoring, batch summarization, and multi-step agent tasks.
items.detail:
MiniMax M3.1 Flash 的發布揭開了「玉兔計劃」的神秘面紗。過去幾週，一個匿名為「Space Bunny」的模型悄然登上 OpenRouter 開放榜單首位，業界猜測其真實身份，直至 MiniMax 正式確認。這種以匿名方式進行公開壓力測試的策略，是中國 AI 公司近年常見的發布前驗證手段，讓模型在真實生產流量中接受考驗，同時保留時機上的靈活性。

從評測數字看，M3.1 Flash 在代理任務方面展現出明顯優勢。在專門衡量多步驟自主任務的 Agents' Last Exam（ALE）中，該模型以 29.6% 的得分超越目前所有公開的中國模型，在 AutomationBench 辦公自動化基準中得 43 分，在 OSWorld V2 電腦操作評測中更達到 61.2 分。值得注意的是，這批評測並非由 MiniMax 自行發布，而是由第三方評測機構同步驗證，可信度相對較高。

定價是此次發布最受關注的部分。M3.1 Flash 的輸入定價為每百萬 token 一元人民幣，輸出為每百萬 token 四元人民幣，綜合成本較上一代 M3 下降逾七成。MiniMax 同步建議用戶在業務高峰時段路由至 M3.1 Flash，在非高峰期轉用 DeepSeek 等其他低成本模型，以進一步壓低批量處理的整體 API 支出。輸出速度達每秒 200 個 token 以上，顯著高於此前版本。

對代理商而言，M3.1 Flash 最直接的應用場景在於需要多步驟決策的批量工作流——例如跨多個廣告平台的帳戶診斷、每日自動化素材品質審核，以及與客戶報表系統的代理式整合。模型支援跨 SaaS 企業工作流，開發者可透過 MiniMax 開放 API 接入，無需等待企業版額外授權。中國區代理商若正在評估自建 AI 自動化工具的技術棧，M3.1 Flash 提供了一條比境外模型更符合合規要求、同時成本顯著降低的路徑。
items.detail_en:
MiniMax M3.1 Flash confirmed weeks of speculation: the anonymous "Space Bunny" model that had been topping OpenRouter's open benchmark charts was MiniMax's next-generation flagship agent model. The anonymous pre-launch testing strategy — letting the model handle real production traffic before official announcement — has become a common validation approach among Chinese AI companies, combining live stress testing with flexibility around timing.

The benchmark results position M3.1 Flash as a meaningful step forward in agentic task performance. On the Agents' Last Exam (ALE), designed to measure multi-step autonomous task completion, the model scored 29.6%, ranking first among all publicly available Chinese models. AutomationBench returned 43 points for office automation workflows, and OSWorld V2 reached 61.2%. These benchmarks were verified by third-party evaluators rather than self-reported by MiniMax, which adds credibility to the published figures.

The pricing structure is where M3.1 Flash makes its clearest commercial statement. At 1 RMB per million input tokens and 4 RMB per million output tokens, the cost is roughly 70% lower than the previous M3 generation. MiniMax suggests routing strategies: direct peak-hour traffic to M3.1 Flash for performance-sensitive tasks, then switch to lower-cost models like DeepSeek during off-peak hours to minimize batch processing costs. Output speed of 200+ tokens per second makes it practical for time-sensitive production workflows.

For agencies operating in China, M3.1 Flash addresses a genuine gap: a high-performing, locally compliant agent model that can handle multi-step workflows across SaaS platforms without the compliance friction of using overseas models. Practical use cases include automated cross-platform account diagnostics, daily creative quality auditing at scale, and agent-driven integration with client reporting systems. The open API is available without enterprise-level licensing, lowering the barrier for agencies evaluating whether to build proprietary AI automation tooling in-house.

items.title: Salesforce 以 56 億美元收購 Braze，整合 Agentforce 推動 AI 驅動即時行銷
items.title_en: Salesforce Acquires Braze for $5.6B to Supercharge Agentforce With Real-Time AI Marketing
items.summary: Salesforce 宣布以 56 億美元全現金收購客戶互動平台 Braze，計劃整合至 Marketing Cloud 及 Agentforce，讓 AI 代理以 Braze 的跨渠道即時觸達能力驅動個人化行銷；Braze 品牌維持不變，交易預計於 Salesforce 2028 財年內完成。
items.summary_en: Salesforce announced a $5.6B all-cash acquisition of Braze, planning to integrate it with Marketing Cloud and Agentforce so AI agents can drive real-time personalized engagement across channels; Braze retains its brand with the deal expected to close in FY2028.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Braze 是代理商管理推播通知、電郵與 SMS 的核心工具；被 Salesforce 收購後，整合方式與定價結構可能重組。
items.why_en: Braze is a core tool agencies use for push, email, and SMS automation; the Salesforce acquisition could reshape how it integrates and is priced.
highlights: Salesforce 以每股 47.5 美元、較前收市價溢價 58% 收購 Braze，交易預計於 Salesforce 2028 財年內完成。
Braze 服務約 2,770 個客戶（包括 Canva、Instacart、Venmo），收購後品牌維持不變，繼續獨立運營。
整合目標是讓 Agentforce AI 代理透過 Braze 的跨渠道能力，在正確時機自動觸達正確用戶，實現規模化個人化行銷。
highlights_en: Salesforce offered $47.50 per share — a 58% premium — for Braze, with the deal expected to close in Salesforce's FY2028.
Braze serves about 2,770 customers including Canva, Instacart, and Venmo; the brand will be retained and the company will continue operating independently.
The integration goal is to let Agentforce AI agents trigger cross-channel personalized engagements through Braze at the right moment and at scale.
items.detail:
Salesforce 宣布以 56 億美元全現金方式收購客戶互動平台 Braze，每股收購價為 47.50 美元，較 Braze 前一個交易日收盤價溢價 58%。交易尚需 Braze 股東批准及監管機構審核，預計於 Salesforce 2028 財政年度完成交割。Braze 擁有約 2,770 家企業客戶，涵蓋 Canva、Instacart、Dairy Queen、Urban Outfitters、Venmo 及 Equinox 等知名品牌，覆蓋消費品、零售、金融及健康等多個垂直行業。

收購完成後，Braze 的實時互動能力將整合進 Salesforce Marketing Cloud、Data 360 平台，以及 Salesforce 正在積極推進的 AI Agent 基礎設施 Agentforce。Braze 的核心優勢在於能夠即時捕捉用戶行為信號，並跨越移動推播、電郵、SMS、WhatsApp 及網頁等多個渠道，動態調整互動內容，取代傳統固定式行銷流程。Salesforce 產品主管 Patrick Stokes 形容 Braze「能夠把客戶的即時行為轉化為個性化互動」，Braze 創辦人兼 CEO Bill Magnuson 則強調「行銷人員的創意是品牌最終競爭優勢」。

Salesforce 近年收購規模持續擴大，此前已以約 277 億美元收購 Slack，並於 2025 年 11 月以約 80 億美元完成收購數據整合商 Informatica。Braze 收購是 Salesforce 在 Agent 時代布局的最新一步，旨在將企業內部 CRM 數據與消費者端的實時行為打通，形成從意圖識別到多渠道觸達的完整閉環。收購完成後，Braze 將保留獨立品牌，並維持多平台開放策略，現有客戶的現有整合架構不受影響。

此次交易的戰略意涵在於，Salesforce 正從純粹的企業軟件供應商轉型為 AI 驅動的行銷執行層。Braze 補強了 Agentforce 在消費者觸達環節的短板，令 Salesforce 在與 Adobe Experience Cloud、HubSpot 等競品的競爭中取得更完整的產品組合。
items.detail_en:
Salesforce has agreed to acquire Braze in an all-cash deal valued at US$5.6 billion, or US$47.50 per share — a 58% premium to Braze's prior closing price. The transaction requires Braze shareholder approval and regulatory clearance, with closing expected in Salesforce's fiscal year 2028. Braze serves approximately 2,770 enterprise clients including Canva, Instacart, Dairy Queen, Urban Outfitters, Venmo, and Equinox, spanning consumer goods, retail, fintech, and fitness verticals.

Upon closing, Braze's real-time engagement technology will be folded into Salesforce Marketing Cloud, the Data 360 platform, and Agentforce — Salesforce's expanding AI agent infrastructure. Braze's core capability is converting live customer behavioral signals into personalized, cross-channel interactions across mobile push, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and web, replacing static campaign journeys with dynamic AI-optimized flows. Patrick Stokes of Salesforce described Braze as built to "turn live customer behavior into personalized engagement at scale," while Braze CEO Bill Magnuson emphasized that "marketers and their creativity are a brand's ultimate competitive advantage."

The acquisition follows a string of major Salesforce deals: the approximately US$27.7 billion Slack purchase and the US$8 billion Informatica acquisition completed in November 2025. Braze adds consumer-facing automation that complements those enterprise-oriented acquisitions. Post-acquisition, Braze will retain its brand identity and maintain an open, multi-platform approach, protecting existing customer integrations.

Strategically, this move signals Salesforce's evolution from a CRM software vendor into an AI-driven marketing execution layer, directly competing with Adobe Experience Cloud and HubSpot for end-to-end marketing stack ownership.

items.title: Apple WebKit 團隊公開解釋 Safari 封鎖 LiveRamp 等身份解析商的技術理由
items.title_en: Apple's WebKit Team Publicly Explains Why It Blocked LiveRamp and Other Identity Resolution Providers
items.summary: Apple WebKit 團隊公開說明九月封鎖 LiveRamp、ID5、UID 2.0 等身份解析商的技術理由，指其透過第一方儲存技術實現跨網站追蹤，違反 Safari 隱私保護原則；與此同時，Apple 廣告業務持續擴張，業界對其雙重角色的公平性提出質疑。
items.summary_en: Apple's WebKit team publicly explained why it blocked LiveRamp, ID5, and UID 2.0 in September, citing cross-site tracking via first-party storage techniques that violate Safari's privacy principles; the industry questioned Apple's neutrality as its own ad business continues to expand.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 代理商使用第三方身份識別工具投放 Safari 用戶的策略，需重新評估替代方案與第一方數據部署。
items.why_en: Agencies using third-party identity tools to target Safari users need to reassess alternatives and first-party data deployment strategies.
items.followup: 10 月 13 日我們報過 Apple iOS 27 封鎖廣告追蹤商、eCPM 首週跌逾一成；14 日更新指封鎖範圍擴至 The Trade Desk。今日 Apple WebKit 團隊首次公開解釋技術理由，點名封鎖 LiveRamp、ID5、UID 2.0 等身份解析商，並在同一天 FTC 剛批准 Publicis 以 22 億美元收購 LiveRamp——監管批准附加五年中立服務條款，令身份解析市場的競爭格局更形複雜。
items.followup_en: On Oct 13 we covered Apple iOS 27 blocking ad trackers with eCPM dropping over 10% in the first week; Oct 14 reported the block extending to The Trade Desk. Today Apple's WebKit team publicly named LiveRamp, ID5, and UID 2.0 as blocked providers — and on the same day, the FTC approved Publicis' $2.2B LiveRamp acquisition with five-year neutrality conditions, adding a new layer of complexity to the identity resolution landscape.
items.pattern: 身份解析市場正在雙向收壓：Apple 從技術端封鎖，FTC 從監管端附條件放行 Publicis 收購 LiveRamp。獨立的身份解析供應商中長期空間持續縮小，第一方數據對代理商的議價價值正在加速上升。
items.pattern_en: Identity resolution is caught between two forces: Apple blocking from the technical side, the FTC conditionally approving Publicis acquiring LiveRamp from the regulatory side. Independent identity providers face a narrowing runway; first-party data is rapidly increasing in agency negotiating value.
highlights: Apple WebKit 團隊公開指明 LiveRamp、ID5、UID 2.0 透過第一方儲存技術繞過 Safari 的跨網站追蹤防護，違反其設計原則。
業界質疑 Apple 在封鎖競爭對手追蹤技術的同時，正大力發展自身廣告網路（Apple Search Ads、App Store 廣告），存在雙重標準。
代理商在 Safari 投放廣告的工具選擇正在收窄，第一方數據、情境定向與 Apple 原生廣告工具成為應對方向。
highlights_en: Apple WebKit publicly named LiveRamp, ID5, and UID 2.0 as providers that use first-party storage techniques to circumvent Safari's cross-site tracking protections.
The industry questioned Apple's dual role: blocking competitor tracking technologies while aggressively growing its own ad network through Apple Search Ads and App Store ads.
Agency options for targeting Safari users are narrowing; first-party data, contextual targeting, and Apple-native ad tools are the emerging response.
items.detail:
Apple WebKit 團隊近期發布技術說明，公開闡述 Safari 封鎖多家身份解析服務商的技術理由。被封鎖的名單包括 LiveRamp、ID5、The Trade Desk 旗下 UID 2.0、Permutive 及 Audigent，覆蓋範圍適用於 iPhone、iPad、Mac 與 Vision Pro，封鎖於軟件更新後自動生效。WebKit 的核心論點是：電郵地址已取代第三方 Cookie 成為跨站追蹤的主要工具——當用戶在網站輸入電郵後，第三方服務商會將其雜湊化，轉換成能跨裝置、跨登出狀態持續存在的持久識別符，隨時間積累成精細的身份圖譜（identity graph）。Safari 的應對方式是直接封鎖相關服務商的整個網域，而非過濾個別請求，以阻斷技術繞道的可能性。

業界對此反應不一，部分廠商對封鎖機制的透明度提出質疑。Apple 在發布說明時未有點名任何被封鎖的公司，亦未公開入選或移除封鎖名單的具體標準。至少一宗誤封事故已獲確認：The Trade Desk 的廣告伺服器曾被意外納入封鎖清單，事後才予以恢復。一名廣告科技業高管直言，Apple 同時控制操作系統、瀏覽器引擎與技術基礎設施，令業界擔憂這種封鎖權力實際上形同市場準入控制。

質疑的聲音更深植於 Apple 自身廣告業務的急速擴張。Apple Ads 目前開設 86 個職位招聘，其中包括地圖廣告業務拓展、廣告算法總監及 AI/ML 產品經理等職能，內部團隊「Signals Intelligence」已引入大型語言模型用於廣告標記與排名。Apple 旗下應用安裝廣告的市場份額在 ATT 政策實施後，從 17% 大幅躍升至 58%，Meta 同期損失約 100 億美元收入。回顧 2017 年智能追蹤防護（ITP）的推出，亦曾重創 Criteo 業務。

現任 CEO John Ternus 接替 Tim Cook 後，繼續強調服務業務增長目標。分析人士指出，Apple 以隱私技術理由阻斷競爭對手的追蹤基礎設施，同時壯大自己的第一方廣告生態，構成外界所稱的「雙重標準」困境，亦令監管機構對廣告科技整合的審查日趨收緊。
items.detail_en:
Apple's WebKit team published a technical explanation for Safari's blocklist, covering companies including LiveRamp, ID5, The Trade Desk's UID 2.0, Permutive, and Audigent. The blocks apply across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro upon software updates. WebKit's stated rationale centers on email addresses having replaced third-party cookies as the primary cross-site tracking mechanism: when users enter emails on websites, third-party firms hash them into persistent identifiers that survive device switches and logouts, accumulating into detailed identity graphs over time. Safari counters this by blocking entire domains of targeted firms rather than filtering individual requests, closing off technical workarounds.

The policy has drawn criticism on transparency grounds. Apple named no companies in its public post and disclosed no criteria for blocklist inclusion or removal. At least one confirmed accidental block occurred — The Trade Desk's ad server was swept in and later restored. An ad-tech executive at a publisher noted that Apple "controls the operating system, the browser engine and increasingly the technical infrastructure," framing the blocklist as a form of market-access control rather than pure privacy enforcement.

These concerns are amplified by Apple's own expanding advertising business. Apple Ads currently has 86 open roles, including positions for Maps advertising expansion, a director of ads algorithms, and AI/ML product managers. An internal team called "Signals Intelligence" uses large language models for ad labeling and ranking. Apple's app install advertising market share surged from 17% to 58% following the ATT rollout that cost Meta roughly US$10 billion in 2022, echoing the 2017 ITP launch that severely damaged Criteo.

New CEO John Ternus, who succeeded Tim Cook last month, has signaled continued services revenue growth. Critics argue that Apple simultaneously dismantles competitors' tracking infrastructure on privacy grounds while building its own first-party ad ecosystem — a structural tension now attracting closer regulatory scrutiny of ad-tech consolidation.

items.title: FTC 批准 Publicis 以 22 億美元收購 LiveRamp，附加五年中立服務條款
items.title_en: FTC Approves Publicis' $2.2B LiveRamp Acquisition With Five-Year Neutrality Conditions
items.summary: 美國聯邦貿易委員會批准 Publicis Groupe 收購 LiveRamp，同時要求 Publicis 在五年內向競爭對手提供中立、無差別的 LiveRamp 服務存取，並設防火牆阻止 Publicis 存取競品客戶數據，以保護數位廣告生態競爭格局。
items.summary_en: The FTC approved Publicis' acquisition of LiveRamp while requiring five-year neutral, nondiscriminatory access for competitors and firewalls preventing Publicis from accessing rivals' client data, to protect the digital ad ecosystem.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 使用 LiveRamp 的代理商需留意：Publicis 控股後，長期定價與服務優先次序存在變數，五年中立條款提供緩衝期。
items.why_en: Agencies relying on LiveRamp should note that Publicis ownership introduces uncertainty on long-term pricing and service priority; the five-year neutrality clause provides a buffer period.
highlights: FTC 要求 Publicis 向競爭對手（含非 Publicis 系代理商）提供中立、無差別的 LiveRamp 服務存取，條款有效期五年。
Publicis 須設立防火牆，禁止透過 LiveRamp 存取競品廣告代理商的客戶數據，防止不公平競爭優勢。
此次收購令 Publicis 同時持有廣告代理服務與核心身份解析基礎設施，行業關注五年後條款到期的後續走向。
highlights_en: The FTC mandated five-year neutral and nondiscriminatory LiveRamp access for all competitors, including non-Publicis agencies.
Publicis must maintain firewalls preventing access to rival clients' data through LiveRamp, blocking unfair competitive advantage.
The deal gives Publicis dual control over agency services and core identity infrastructure; the industry is watching what happens when the five-year conditions expire.
items.detail:
美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）於 2026 年 10 月 20 日正式批准 Publicis Groupe 以 22 億美元收購數據連通平台 LiveRamp Holdings，並附加具約束力的競爭中立條款。根據 FTC 裁令，相關條款效期為五年，Publicis 須確保以「中立且不歧視」的方式向市場提供 LiveRamp 旗下全線產品及服務，各競爭對手廣告代理商的存取權限受到同等保障。

FTC 同時要求 Publicis 建立防火牆機制，嚴格隔離 LiveRamp 在業務執行過程中所接觸的競爭對手客戶數據，防止 Publicis 利用 LiveRamp 的數據連通樞紐地位，獲取競品客戶的受眾資料或行銷策略情報。FTC 競爭局首席副局長 David Shaw 表示，此項裁令旨在「確保 Publicis 不會在競爭對手面前取得不公平優勢」，以維護數字廣告生態系統的競爭格局。

LiveRamp 是全球最具規模的數據連通平台之一，負責在廣告主、媒體平台與數據供應商之間建立安全的身份匹配橋樑，其技術架構支撐著大量第三方廣告生態系統中的受眾定向與效果歸因流程。Publicis 收購 LiveRamp 的戰略邏輯在於以數據基礎設施整合行銷服務，強化其跨平台受眾觸達能力；FTC 附加中立條款，正是針對此種縱向整合可能對行業生態造成的封閉效應所設的護欄。

此次裁決折射出 FTC 對廣告科技行業整合浪潮的整體監管立場正在收緊。在 Apple 收緊 Safari 封鎖名單、Google 推遲停用第三方 Cookie 等行業巨變背景下，LiveRamp 的身份解析服務具有更強的替代性戰略價值，FTC 的五年中立條款也因此受到業界的高度關注。
items.detail_en:
The U.S. Federal Trade Commission approved Publicis Groupe's US$2.2 billion acquisition of LiveRamp Holdings on October 20, 2026, subject to a binding set of neutrality conditions effective for five years. Under the FTC order, Publicis must provide "neutral and nondiscriminatory access" to all LiveRamp products and services, ensuring competing advertising agencies retain equal access to the platform's data connectivity capabilities.

The order also requires Publicis to erect firewalls preventing its teams from accessing competitor client data that flows through LiveRamp's infrastructure. The intent is to block Publicis from leveraging LiveRamp's position as a central identity-resolution hub to extract audience intelligence or campaign strategy data belonging to rival agencies. David Shaw, principal deputy director of the FTC Bureau of Competition, stated the order will ensure "Publicis does not gain an unfair advantage over its competitors" in the digital advertising ecosystem.

LiveRamp operates as one of the world's largest data connectivity platforms, enabling secure identity matching between advertisers, media platforms, and data providers. Its infrastructure underpins audience targeting and attribution workflows across much of the third-party advertising ecosystem. Publicis sought to acquire LiveRamp to vertically integrate data infrastructure into its marketing services offering; the FTC's neutrality mandate directly targets the potential foreclosure effects of that vertical integration.

The ruling reflects the FTC's escalating scrutiny of ad-tech consolidation. Against a backdrop of Apple tightening Safari blocklists and Google repeatedly delaying third-party cookie deprecation, LiveRamp's identity resolution services carry heightened strategic value — making the five-year neutrality window a closely watched industry constraint.

items.title: Meta Muse 40 天美國下載破千萬，七日留存率 30% 遠高於同類均值
items.title_en: Meta Muse Hits 10M US Downloads in 40 Days With 30% Retention, Far Above Category Average
items.summary: Meta AI 代理應用 Muse 上線 40 天達成逾 1,020 萬美國下載量，七日留存率 30% 遠超同類應用均值 19%；Meta 在 10 月份將 39% 的廣告預算集中投入 Muse 推廣，以數字宣示 AI 助理應用進入成長加速期。
items.summary_en: Meta's Muse AI agent app crossed 10.2M US downloads in 40 days with a 30% seven-day retention rate, far above the 19% category average; Meta committed 39% of its October ad budget to Muse promotion, signaling an acceleration phase.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Muse 快速達標意味著 Meta 廣告生態將圍繞 AI 代理深度重組，代理商需提前研究 Muse 廣告版位的進入時機。
items.why_en: Muse's rapid growth signals Meta's ad ecosystem will reorganize around AI agents; agencies need to evaluate Muse ad placements before the curve steepens.

Today's first scorecard: 10.2M US downloads in 40 days, 30% seven-day retention — well above the 19% category average — with Meta committing 39% of its October ad budget to Muse promotion, signaling an all-in bet on AI agents as the primary consumer interface.
items.pattern: 隨著 Muse 消費習慣成形，下一個問題是廣告如何在 AI 代理對話中呈現。Meta 在 ChatGPT 廣告測試結果公布前已開始自答——Muse 的留存率數據，正是向代理商推銷 AI 代理廣告版位的最佳說辭。
items.pattern_en: As Muse usage habits form, the next question is how ads appear inside AI agent conversations. Meta is pre-answering before ChatGPT ad test results come in — Muse's retention data is the sales pitch for its agent ad placements.
highlights: Meta Muse 在上線 40 天內達成 1,020 萬美國下載量，在歷史紀錄中僅有另外 11 款應用曾在同等時間內達到此里程碑。

highlights_en: Meta Muse reached 10.2M US downloads in 40 days — only 11 other apps in history hit this milestone in the same timeframe.
Its 30% seven-day retention rate significantly exceeds the 19% AI assistant category average, showing strong habit formation after first use.
Meta allocated 39% of its October ad budget to promoting Muse, reflecting its bet that AI agent apps will become the primary consumer interface.
items.detail:
Meta 旗下 AI 助理應用 Muse 於 2026 年 9 月正式推出，至 10 月 20 日前後累計達成 1,020 萬次美國下載，全球下載總量達 1,090 萬次，成功在 40 天內突破千萬關口。根據 Sensor Tower 數據，史上能在美國市場於 40 天內完成這一里程碑的應用僅有 12 款，其餘知名成員包括 Threads、Disney+、Fortnite、PUBG Mobile 與 Pokémon GO，而這些成功案例過去主要集中於手機遊戲類別，令 Muse 作為非遊戲 AI 應用的成就更為突出。

留存數據同樣顯著高於行業均值。Muse 在美國的七日用戶留存率為 30%，遠超 AI 同類應用均值 19%；十四日留存率 23%，亦高於同類均值 16%。10 月 16 日單日活躍用戶達 250 萬，較前一週上升 15%。Muse 自發布以來幾乎每日佔據美國 App Store 排行榜首位，10 月 19 日曾短暫被串流媒體應用 Kick 取代；在 Google Play 方面，過去 30 天排名持續第一。目前 Muse 僅在美國及加拿大提供服務，尚未擴展至其他市場。

相比其他 AI 競品，Muse 的增長速度差距顯著：ChatGPT 在同等 40 天時間窗口內美國下載量為 370 萬次，Grok 為 50 萬次，Claude 為 20 萬次。ChatGPT 曾創下全球 40 天 1,500 萬次下載的記錄，但其中約 25% 來自日本單一市場，依賴國際受眾的程度遠高於 Muse 的純美國本土增長。

Meta 的分發優勢是推動這一增速的核心槓桿。Muse 在 Facebook、Instagram 等平台合計 36 億日活用戶的社交圖譜中交叉推廣，策略類似當年利用 Instagram 用戶基礎推出 Threads 的打法。廣告投入亦快速加碼：Muse 在 Meta 全平台廣告印象排名中，10 月已從 9 月的第 73 位躍升至第 21 位，廣告投放比例從 9 月的 23% 升至 10 月的 39%。Sensor Tower 高級分析師 Kara Lee 指出，Muse 的成就說明非遊戲類應用在具備足夠分發優勢的條件下，同樣可以複製過去只有大型移動遊戲才能達到的增長曲線。
items.detail_en:
Meta's AI agent app Muse, launched in September 2026, reached 10.2 million U.S. downloads and 10.9 million global downloads within its first 40 days, measured through approximately October 20, 2026. According to Sensor Tower, only 12 apps in history have achieved the 10-million-U.S.-downloads-in-40-days milestone, with prior members including Threads, Disney+, Fortnite, PUBG Mobile, and Pokémon GO — a group composed largely of mobile games, making Muse's achievement as a non-game AI app particularly notable.

Retention metrics reinforce the growth story. Muse's U.S. seven-day retention rate stands at 30%, versus a 19% average for AI app peers; its 14-day retention of 23% similarly exceeds the peer average of 16%. Daily active users reached 2.5 million on October 16, a 15% week-over-week gain. Muse held the top position on the U.S. App Store nearly every day since launch — briefly displaced on October 19 by streaming app Kick — and ranked first on Google Play over the past 30 days. The app is currently available only in the U.S. and Canada.

Competitive context sharpens the picture: ChatGPT recorded approximately 3.7 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, Grok 500,000, and Claude 200,000. ChatGPT's global 40-day tally of roughly 15 million was boosted by Japan alone accounting for 25% of installs, making its figure less comparable to Muse's U.S.-concentrated performance.

Meta's distribution infrastructure is the primary growth lever. Cross-promotion across 3.6 billion daily active users on Facebook and Instagram mirrors the strategy that turbocharged Threads via Instagram's social graph. Ad investment has escalated in tandem: Muse climbed from 73rd to 21st in U.S. advertising impressions rankings between September and October, with Meta's allocated ad spend share rising from 23% to 39%. Sensor Tower senior insights analyst Kara Lee noted the achievement demonstrates that non-game apps can replicate mobile gaming growth curves when backed by sufficient distribution scale.

items.title: Google 為 Android Auto 推出個人化 Gemini：整合 Gmail、日曆與 Maps 提供行車情境輔助
items.title_en: Google Brings Personalized Gemini to Android Auto With Gmail, Calendar, and Maps Integration
items.summary: Google 在 Android Auto 推出「Personal Intelligence with Gemini」功能，整合用戶 Gmail、日曆、地圖及 YouTube 記錄，行車中可即時提供個人化情境輔助（如「會前目的地提醒」），為選擇性啟用功能，首批向美國用戶推出。
items.summary_en: Google launched Personal Intelligence with Gemini for Android Auto, integrating Gmail, Calendar, Maps, and YouTube history for personalized in-car context — such as pre-meeting destination reminders — as an opt-in feature rolling out to U.S. users first.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Google 將 AI 助理延伸至行車情境，為車內廣告與情境化觸達開闢新版位，代理商需追蹤 Android Auto 廣告生態的演變。
items.why_en: Google extending AI assistance into driving opens new in-car ad placements and contextual targeting; agencies should monitor the Android Auto ad ecosystem evolution.
highlights: 「Personal Intelligence with Gemini」整合 Gmail、Google 日曆、Maps 導航記錄及 YouTube 串流歷史，在行車中提供個人化情境輔助。
功能為選擇性啟用，用戶需主動開啟才能授予 Gemini 存取個人資料的權限，Google 以此回應私隱顧慮。
功能首批向美國 Android Auto 用戶推出，標誌著 Google Gemini 從手機擴展至車內情境的重要布局步驟。
highlights_en: Personal Intelligence with Gemini connects Gmail, Calendar, Maps history, and YouTube streams to deliver contextual in-car assistance.
The feature is opt-in, requiring users to explicitly grant Gemini personal data access to address privacy concerns.
The rollout starts with U.S. Android Auto users, marking a key step in Gemini's expansion from mobile to in-vehicle contexts.
items.detail:
Google 於 2026 年 10 月 20 日正式為 Android Auto 推出「Personal Intelligence with Gemini」功能，將個人 Google 帳戶資料深度整合至行車情境。此功能可串接 Gmail、Google 日曆、YouTube、Google Maps、Google 搜尋紀錄及其他已連結的 Google 服務，讓車內助理能夠理解使用者的個人行程脈絡，而非僅回應通用查詢。使用者可以自然語言提出多部分問題，系統同時作答，例如在前往機場途中詢問班機即時狀態與登機口資訊，助理可結合日曆中的航班資料與 Maps 即時交通一次回覆。

部署方式分為兩條路徑：其一為 Android Auto，即以手機為底層、將介面投射至車輛娛樂螢幕；其二為 Google Built-in，軟體直接內嵌於車輛系統，預計數月內擴展至更多兼容車型。Personal Intelligence 功能於 2026 年 3 月已在美國推出並進入公測，Android Auto 整合版本則以此為基礎延伸至行車情境，目前全球其他市場仍處於測試階段，尚未公布明確推廣時間表。

Gemini 最初於 2025 年 11 月進入 Android Auto，彼時功能以通用語音問答為主，尚未打通個人資料層。此次更新的關鍵轉變在於「個人化」——助理不再是泛用模型，而是能讀取使用者本人的郵件、行程與地圖偏好。為應對私隱顧慮，Google 採用明確的加入機制（opt-in），使用者可隨時切換開關，並可自行選擇開放哪些應用程式的資料存取權限。

Google 未公布此功能的獨立收費，預料包含於現有 Android Auto 生態系統內。然而，資料整合的深度亦引發外界對私隱邊界的討論——車內環境屬於相對封閉的私人空間，個人郵件與行程資料透過語音介面呈現，可能令部分用戶感到不適。目前暫無與 Apple CarPlay、Amazon Alexa Auto 等競品的直接比較數據發布。
items.detail_en:
Google officially launched 'Personal Intelligence with Gemini' for Android Auto on October 20, 2026, marking a significant shift from general-purpose voice assistance toward context-aware, personalized driving support. The feature draws on a user's Gmail, Google Calendar, YouTube, Google Maps, search history, and other connected Google services to answer multi-part natural language queries in a single response. A representative use case: a driver en route to the airport can ask simultaneously about flight delay status and gate information, with the assistant synthesizing calendar data and Maps real-time conditions into one reply.

Deployment follows two paths. Android Auto projects the interface from the user's phone to the car's infotainment screen and went live on launch day. Google Built-in — where the software is embedded directly in the vehicle — will expand to compatible cars 'in the coming months,' with no specific models or OEM partners named. Personal Intelligence itself had already rolled out across the U.S. in March 2026 and remains in beta in other global markets, with no confirmed timeline for full international availability.

Gemini first arrived in Android Auto in November 2025, limited to general queries. The October 2026 update adds the personal data layer, enabling the assistant to cross-reference a driver's own schedule, messages, and location preferences rather than relying on anonymized public data. To address privacy concerns, Google requires opt-in consent; users can toggle the feature off at any time and selectively choose which connected apps to authorize.

No separate pricing has been announced; the feature is bundled within the existing Android Auto ecosystem. The depth of data integration — personal email and calendar surfaced through an in-car voice interface — has drawn commentary about privacy comfort levels, even with opt-in controls in place. No direct benchmarks against Apple CarPlay's Siri integration or Amazon Alexa Auto have been published at this time.

items.title: fal 發布 FLUX 3 Max 影片生成模型：速度比 Seedance 2.5 快 22 倍，支援 1080p 輸出
items.title_en: fal Launches FLUX 3 Max Video Generation Model: 22× Faster Than Seedance 2.5 at 1080p
items.summary: fal 基於 Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 推出影片生成模型 FLUX 3 Max，主打速度優勢——10 秒片段僅需約 12 秒生成，聲稱比 Seedance 2.5 快 22 倍，支援文字轉影片及圖像轉影片，最高 1080p 解析度，API 已開放。
items.summary_en: fal launched FLUX 3 Max video generation model on Black Forest Labs FLUX 3, claiming 22× faster generation than Seedance 2.5 — a 10-second clip in ~12 seconds — supporting text-to-video and image-to-video at up to 1080p via open API.
items.why: 速度提升 22 倍意味著代理商可在提案當日快速生成多個影片概念版本，大幅壓縮創意迭代周期。
items.why_en: A 22× speed advantage means agencies can generate multiple video concept variants on pitch day, dramatically compressing creative iteration cycles.
highlights: fal FLUX 3 Max 可在約 12 秒內生成 10 秒影片片段，速度聲稱比業界常用的 Seedance 2.5 快 22 倍。
支援文字轉影片及圖像轉影片兩種模式，最高輸出解析度 1080p，適合社交媒體廣告素材的快速生產。
API 已透過 fal.ai 平台開放存取，可直接整合進代理商的廣告素材批量生成工作流程。
highlights_en: fal FLUX 3 Max generates a 10-second video clip in approximately 12 seconds, claiming a 22× speed advantage over the widely-used Seedance 2.5.
The model supports both text-to-video and image-to-video modes at up to 1080p resolution, suited for rapid social media ad creative production.
The API is publicly accessible via fal.ai and can be integrated directly into agency ad creative batch generation workflows.
items.detail:
fal.ai 於 2026 年 10 月 19 日正式發布 FLUX 3 Max 視頻生成模型，宣稱在速度上大幅領先現有競品。根據廠商公布的基準測試數據，生成一段 10 秒、16:9 比例、720p 解析度的片段，FLUX 3 Max 僅需 12.45 秒，而 Dreamina Seedance 2.5 則需 277.80 秒，速度差距約達 22 倍。模型由 fal.ai 與德國機構 Black Forest Labs 合作開發，以 Black Forest Labs 的 FLUX 3 Video 為底層架構，fal.ai 再針對指令跟隨能力與視覺品質進行額外訓練。

功能規格方面，FLUX 3 Max 支援 5 至 20 秒片段輸出，原生解析度為 720p，可選擇升頻至 1080p，並支援橫向、縱向與正方形三種畫面比例。音訊軌道可切換開關。推理精度設有低與高兩檔，選擇高精度時生成速度會相應降低。API 端點涵蓋文字生成視頻、圖片生成視頻（支援首末幀各一張），以及關鍵幀生成視頻（最多可輸入 10 張圖片），生成內容依 fal.ai 使用條款許可商業用途。

定價方面，促銷期內 720p 每秒收費 0.0425 美元，10 秒片段約需 0.425 美元；升頻至 1080p 則每秒 0.0725 美元，10 秒約需 0.725 美元。此七五折促銷優惠有效期至 2026 年 11 月 7 日，屆時正式費率將分別調升至每 10 秒 1.70 美元（720p）與 2.90 美元（1080p）。

品質方面，Artificial Analysis 排行榜（2026 年 10 月 19 日數據）顯示，FLUX 3 Max（720p）的 Elo 評分為 1,138，95% 信賴區間為 1,123 至 1,153；MiniMax H3（768p）得分 1,140，Seedance 2.5 同為 1,138。三者信賴區間高度重疊，無法確立決定性的品質優勢，FLUX 3 Max 的實際排名落在第一至第五之間，結論尚不明朗。值得注意的是，上述速度基準由廠商自行申報，實際表現會因推理設定與工作負載而有所差異；此排行榜亦僅涵蓋含音訊的圖片轉視頻情境，文字轉視頻的品質數據目前仍付之闕如。
items.detail_en:
fal.ai launched FLUX 3 Max on October 19, 2026, positioning the model primarily on generation speed rather than outright quality leadership. Vendor-reported benchmarks show that a 10-second, 16:9, 720p clip generates in 12.45 seconds on FLUX 3 Max versus 277.80 seconds on Dreamina Seedance 2.5 — a roughly 22× difference. The model was developed in partnership with Black Forest Labs (Germany), built on their FLUX 3 Video architecture with fal.ai contributing additional training for instruction-following and visual quality.

Technical specifications include output durations of 5 to 20 seconds, native 720p resolution with optional upscaling to 1080p, and support for landscape, portrait, and square aspect ratios. Audio can be toggled on or off. Inference operates at low or high reasoning settings, with higher settings reducing generation speed. Three API endpoints are available: text-to-video, image-to-video (supporting separate start and end frames), and keyframes-to-video (up to 10 input images). Commercial use of API-generated content is permitted under fal's usage terms.

Pricing during the promotional period is $0.0425 per second at 720p — approximately $0.425 for a 10-second clip — and $0.0725 per second at 1080p (approximately $0.725 per 10-second clip). The 75% promotional discount expires on November 7, 2026, after which standard rates rise to $1.70 per 10 seconds at 720p and $2.90 at 1080p.

On the Artificial Analysis leaderboard (data as of October 19, 2026), FLUX 3 Max at 720p scored an Elo of 1,138 (95% CI: 1,123–1,153), essentially tied with MiniMax H3 at 1,140 and Seedance 2.5 at 1,138 — overlapping confidence intervals prevent any definitive quality ranking, placing FLUX 3 Max anywhere from first to fifth. Two caveats apply: speed benchmarks are vendor-reported under specific conditions (10-second, 16:9, 720p clips) and may not generalize; the quality leaderboard covers image-to-video with audio only and does not address text-to-video scenarios.

items.title: 二線控股集團以 AI 速度差異化競爭，顧問警告 AI 令代理商服務同質化加劇
items.title_en: Second-Tier Holdcos Bet on AI Speed to Differentiate, Consultants Warn It May Homogenize the Industry
items.summary: Dentsu、Havas、Stagwell 等二線控股集團以比三大同業更快的 AI 整合速度作為差異化賣點，試圖在激烈競爭中搶佔位置；業界顧問警告，AI 工具的普及反令整個代理商行業服務更趨同質化，差異化愈來愈難建立。
items.summary_en: Second-tier holdcos including Dentsu, Havas, and Stagwell are positioning faster AI integration as their differentiator against the Big Three, but industry consultants warn that widespread AI adoption may make the entire agency sector more homogenous, making differentiation harder.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 代理商定位正被 AI 重塑：工具趨同後，差異化只能靠人才、客戶關係與垂直行業專業，值得對照自身定位審視。
items.why_en: Agency positioning is being reshaped by AI: as tools converge, differentiation depends on talent, client relationships, and vertical expertise — worth benchmarking against your own.
highlights: Dentsu、Havas、Stagwell 等二線集團強調比三大巨頭架構更靈活，能更快速部署 AI 工具，以此作為新業務競爭的核心賣點。
業界顧問指出，當所有代理商使用相同 AI 平台，服務模式差異縮小，客戶比價將從「能力」轉向「價格」。
Stagwell 同步在本月重組旗下媒體業務，將 Assembly 品牌併入集團架構，精簡 AI 投資的重複開支。
highlights_en: Dentsu, Havas, Stagwell and peers argue that their more agile structures enable faster AI deployment than the Big Three, making this their new business pitch.
Industry consultants warn that universal AI platform adoption narrows service differences, shifting client decisions from capability-based to price-based.
Stagwell simultaneously reorganized its media business this month, folding Assembly into its group structure to eliminate duplicate AI investment.
items.detail:
在廣告傳播業界，Publicis、Omnicom、WPP 三巨頭長期壟斷規模優勢，而 Dentsu、Havas、Stagwell、Horizon 等二線控股集團則陷入定位兩難：體量不及巨頭，靈活性又遜於獨立代理商。顧問公司 ID Comms 的 Tom Denford 直接將 Dentsu、Havas、Horizon 與 Stagwell 定義為「紅海代理商」，並警告「未來三至五年內，其中並非所有機構都能存活」。Co:definery 顧問 Robin Bonn 則以「Goldilocks」形容這批機構——處於獨立代理商與超大型控股之間的夾縫位置，而 AI 的普及正令各層級代理商的服務走向同質化，使差異化愈發困難。

Stagwell 的應對策略最為激進。集團正將旗下媒體代理商 Assembly 重整為技術導向的 Stagwell Media，並由 Slavi Samardzija 主導媒體與商業轉型，核心是將旗下資源整合為統一技術平台「Media Machine」。Forrester 分析師 Pattisall 評價此平台「確實實現了單一統一基礎架構」，認為這一點與多數競品有實質差距。Stagwell 同時積極拓展主理人媒體採購業務，並於近期與日本 ADK Holdings 達成三年戰略合作協議，以日本市場為跳板推進全球布局。人事層面，Nagmeh Taheri 由 Omnicom Media 英國/愛爾蘭區加入，出任 Stagwell 歐洲媒體與商業部門首席增長官。

Dentsu 於同期發布旗下 Carat 品牌新標語「Difference Engineered」，顧問認為其在搜尋、科技與創新領域有實質優勢，其日本母公司背景亦被視為尚未充分挖掘的差異化資產。Havas 則選擇與美國獨立媒體公司 Horizon Media 締結國際合作，以 Horizon 覆蓋北美、Havas 覆蓋歐洲及其他地區的方式拼合地域規模。然而，Havas 2026 年前三季有機淨收入增速僅 2.5%，北美雖錄得 7.1% 增長，但顧問指出主要由收購驅動，整體利潤率約 13%，全年增長指引為 2% 至 3%，表現平淡。Harmonium 的 Hasan Ramusevic 直言 Havas「是這批挑戰者中最難看透的一個」。

AI 在這場競爭中扮演雙面角色：一方面賦予規模較小的機構技術槓桿，另一方面令服務模式趨同，令原本依靠執行差異化的代理商失去護城河。S4 Capital 旗下 Monks 走向另一個極端，宣稱已將更多工作交由可「連續自主運行數日」的 AI 代理人處理，標誌著代理商形態的根本性轉變正在加速。顧問 Ramusevic 認為，當下存在一個視窗機會：若有一家二線機構能同時具備控股集團的規模與精密度，以及獨立代理商的靈活性，或將打破現有格局。
items.detail_en:
The advertising holding company landscape in 2026 presents a structural dilemma for the second tier — Dentsu, Havas, Stagwell, and Horizon — caught between the scale dominance of Publicis, Omnicom, and WPP on one side, and the agility of independent agencies on the other. Tom Denford of ID Comms labelled Dentsu, Havas, Horizon, and Stagwell as 'Red Ocean agencies,' warning that 'not all of them will be around in three to five years.' Robin Bonn of Co:definery described the group as 'Goldilocks' agencies — occupying the middle ground between giants and independents — while noting that AI is driving all players toward service homogeneity, eroding whatever execution-based differentiation once existed.

Stagwell has taken the most aggressive structural approach: rebuilding its Assembly media agency into a tech-forward entity called Stagwell Media, led by Slavi Samardzija, centred on a unified technology stack dubbed 'The Media Machine.' Forrester analyst Pattisall assessed this as 'a significant advancement' representing 'one unified platform' — a substantive claim versus competitors with looser integrations. Stagwell is also pursuing principal media buying revenues through owned media properties and signed a three-year strategic partnership with Japan's ADK Holdings. Personnel moves include Nagmeh Taheri joining from Omnicom Media UK/Ireland as chief growth officer for Stagwell Europe Media & Commerce, and James Townsend transitioning from Stagwell EMEA CEO to MSQ CEO.

Dentsu launched a new Carat tagline — 'Difference Engineered' — and holds recognized strengths in search, technology, and innovation per Forrester, though consultants note its Japanese heritage remains an underutilized differentiator and lingering M&A uncertainty complicates the narrative. Havas has partnered with Horizon Media to stitch together geographic scale, with Horizon covering North America and Havas covering Europe and other markets. The partnership has yet to generate meaningful new business wins; Havas posted 2.5% organic net revenue growth over the first nine months of 2026, with North America up 7.1% (acquisition-driven), margins around 13%, and full-year guidance of 2–3%.

AI plays a dual role across the competitive field: it gives smaller agencies a technology lever, yet simultaneously accelerates homogeneity by commoditizing execution. Monks (S4 Capital) represents the furthest point on this spectrum, having reportedly handed more work to AI agents capable of running 'autonomously, unsupervised for days.' Consultants see a narrow window for whichever challenger can credibly combine holdco-level scale and sophistication with independent-agency agility — but that window may close as AI capabilities equalize across all tiers.

items.title: 創意總監預測 2027 年：AI 令精緻製作商品化，品味與文化洞察成核心競爭力
items.title_en: Creative Directors Predict 2027: AI Commoditizes Polished Production, Taste and Cultural Insight Win
items.summary: 五位新加坡創意總監預測，AI 工具令精緻製作成本趨近零後，2027 年創意競爭將回歸品味、文化洞察與人性瑕疵，而非生產效率；廣告創意的價值主軸將從「做得到」轉向「做得準」。
items.summary_en: Five Singapore creative directors predict that as AI drives polished production costs toward zero, 2027 creative competition will hinge on taste, cultural relevance, and human imperfection — shifting creative value from 'can produce' to 'can judge.'
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: AI 可以替代製作技能，卻難以替代文化判斷，代理商創意服務的定位方向需要相應調整。
items.why_en: AI can replace production skills but not cultural judgment — agencies should reposition their creative value proposition accordingly.
highlights: 五位新加坡頂尖創意總監預測：AI 普及後製作能力本身不再是代理商差異化優勢，品牌需要「有品味的選擇者」而非「有效率的執行者」。
人性瑕疵與文化情感關聯性被視為 AI 難以複製的要素，創意總監認為這兩者將成為 2027 年品牌溢價的主要來源。
受訪創意總監一致建議代理商投資於創意方向、策略洞察與文化理解，而非繼續擴張人力製作資源。
items.detail:
隨著 AI 影像生成工具令精緻製作趨於普及，新加坡五位創意總監於 2026 年 10 月公開預測：2027 年廣告創意的核心競爭將從執行品質轉移至品味判斷與文化洞察。調查數據提供了行業轉型的消費者面向：根據 DoubleVerify「2026 Global Insights: Media Quality in the Age of AI」報告，47% 的新加坡消費者表示會對使用低品質 AI 廣告的品牌產生負面觀感，45% 則對專業製作的 AI 廣告持正面態度。這一組數字說明，消費者並非排斥 AI，而是對製作品質的標準依然存在。

GOODSTUPH（設有新加坡與印尼辦公室）創辦人 Pat Law 的判斷最為直接：「光滑」（polish）將變得無關緊要，能否理解本地文化才是勝負關鍵。她以「咖啡店笑話」（kopitiam jokes）為例，說明在地文化共鳴所能創造的連接，遠超 AI 生成的泛用全球內容。她同時預言，年輕一代的創意人將把工作與生活的平衡置於業界榮耀之上，機構的人才競爭邏輯將因此改變。「我們將停止招募雙手，轉而招募恰好擁有雙手的頭腦。」

VML Singapore 首席創意官 Mateusz Mroszczak 的觀察從製作成本的角度切入：AI 消除了過去讓薄弱創意得以躲藏的昂貴製作盔甲，「當所有人都能把東西做得漂亮，留下來的只有創意本身」。McCann Singapore 行政總裁 Gonzalo Olivera 則將稀缺資源定義為「策略判斷」——判斷什麼值得被製作出來。他認為 AI 正在暴露組織內部緩慢的決策流程，並呼籲代理商將策略、媒體、數據、服務與技術整合為解決「簡報背後問題」的整體方案。The Secret Little Agency 聯合創辦人兼首席創意官 Nicholas Ye 走向更激進的立場，主張凡是 AI 能生成的事物均已淪為商品，提倡帶有具名創作者身份的原創人工作品，以「成為故障本身」作為創意宣言。VaynerMedia 亞太創意總監 Chan Woei Hern 則預測創作者個人 IP 的崛起——優秀的創作者將圍繞受眾的真實喜愛，自行建立品牌、工作室乃至商業版圖。

五位創意人的預測雖各有側重，內在邏輯卻高度一致：當生成式 AI 令精緻製作成為門檻而非優勢，品牌的差異化將倚賴人類的品味、文化在地性與創意判斷力。這一趨勢對廣告主而言意味著，採購創意服務的標準亦需相應調整——從評估執行規格轉向評估洞察深度與文化判讀能力。
items.detail_en:
Five Singapore-based creative directors published 2027 predictions in October 2026 that converge on a single thesis: as generative AI commoditizes production polish, taste, cultural literacy, and strategic judgment become the last defensible creative advantages. Consumer data grounds the argument in market reality. According to DoubleVerify's '2026 Global Insights: Media Quality in the Age of AI,' 47% of Singapore consumers said they would think negatively of brands using low-quality AI ads, while 45% would view professionally produced AI ads positively — indicating that consumers accept AI in advertising but hold production quality to an unchanged standard.

Pat Law, founder of GOODSTUPH (Singapore and Indonesia), argues most bluntly that polish is becoming irrelevant while local cultural resonance is not. She uses kopitiam humor — the shorthand of Singapore's coffee-shop culture — as an example of what generic AI-generated content cannot replicate. She also predicts a talent shift: younger creatives will prioritize work-life balance over industry prestige, forcing agencies to compete on different terms. 'We will stop hiring hands. We will hire heads that happen to have hands.'

VML Singapore CCO Mateusz Mroszczak frames the change through production economics: AI removes the expensive production shield behind which weak ideas once hid. 'When everyone can make something look beautiful, the idea itself is all that's left.' McCann Singapore CEO Gonzalo Olivera identifies strategic judgment — knowing what deserves to exist — as the true scarcity, and argues that AI is exposing slow organizational decision-making. Nicholas Ye, co-founder and CCO of The Secret Little Agency, takes the most radical stance: anything AI can generate is already commoditized, and advocates for human-authored work with named authorship, calling on creatives to 'be the glitch.' VaynerMedia APAC head of creative Chan Woei Hern predicts the rise of individual creative empires — creators building IP, studios, and businesses from audience love rather than agency structures.

For marketers, the collective prediction carries a procurement implication: evaluating creative partners on execution specifications alone will become an inadequate filter. The differentiating question shifts to whether an agency or creator possesses the cultural insight and editorial taste that AI cannot yet replicate at scale.

items.title: 法庭文件揭示 TikTok 管理層忽視員工安全警示，現與 Meta、Google 合面對逾百宗合併訴訟
items.title_en: Court Docs Reveal TikTok Execs Ignored Employee Safety Warnings; Now Faces 100+ Consolidated Lawsuits
items.summary: 法庭文件顯示 TikTok 員工曾多次就未成年人安全問題向管理層示警，高層未採取行動；TikTok 現與 Meta、Google、Snap 合併面對數百宗平台傷害未成年人的訴訟，此案將對社群平台廣告責任框架產生深遠影響。
items.summary_en: Court documents reveal TikTok employees repeatedly warned executives about underage safety risks, but leadership failed to act; TikTok now faces hundreds of consolidated lawsuits alongside Meta, Google, and Snap, with major implications for social platform advertising liability.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 品牌安全策略應將平台訴訟風險納入評估，廣告主對社群平台的品牌關聯性審查正在加深。
items.why_en: Brand safety strategies should now factor in platform litigation risk; advertiser scrutiny of social platform brand associations is deepening.
highlights: 法庭文件顯示 TikTok 員工就未成年人安全問題提出具體警示，公司高層未採取相應措施，文件已於訴訟中正式提交。
TikTok 現與 Meta、Google、Snap 合併面對數百宗訴訟，指控四大平台明知產品對未成年人有害仍繼續運營。
此案走勢將影響社群平台修改廣告定向規則的節奏，代理商的品牌安全評估框架需同步更新以應對新法律環境。
highlights_en: Court documents show TikTok employees filed specific warnings about underage safety risks, but company leadership failed to respond — the documents have been formally submitted in litigation.
TikTok now faces hundreds of consolidated lawsuits alongside Meta, Google, and Snap, alleging that all four knowingly operated products harmful to minors.
The case trajectory will influence how social platforms revise ad-targeting rules to reduce legal exposure, requiring agencies to update brand safety frameworks.

2026 年 3 月，一批在庭審中呈堂的證詞文件由 NPR 取得並公開報道，揭示 TikTok 內部員工曾多次就未成年人安全問題向管理層提出警示，然而管理層據報未有採取相應行動。文件所指的安全隱患涵蓋多個維度：未成年人出現於平台上可供付費購買的性化內容之中；未成年用戶透過漏洞繞過年齡限制，接觸本應受限的內容；未成年人刻意對家長隱瞞平台活動；以及用戶接觸與自殺相關的內容。其中一項尤為值得關注的決策是：TikTok 刻意迴避對用戶年齡進行問卷調查，原因是一旦掌握此類數據，便需向美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）披露。

目前，TikTok 與 Meta、Google（YouTube）及 Snap 同時面臨數以百計的聯邦合併訴訟，核心指控為各平台對未成年人造成傷害，且平台方蓄意隱瞞已知風險。案件在聯邦法院層面整合審理，部分個案已由 TikTok 在正式開庭前達成和解。與此同時，洛杉磯一個陪審團已就其中部分案件作出裁決，認定 Meta 與 YouTube 蓄意將平台設計為令年輕用戶上癮的工具。

對於上述文件披露，TikTok 發言人反駁稱，相關援引與主張「顯然出於訴訟律師的授意而經過選擇性篩選」，並強調集團「已在信任與安全領域投入數十億美元」。然而，這批證詞文件屬於正式庭審程序的一部分，其證明力有待法庭最終裁定。

此案的行業意涵在於：平台對未成年用戶保護的內部決策流程，正在法律程序中受到前所未有的直接審視。員工曾就安全風險提出警示而管理層不作為的指控，若在庭審中成立，將為平台的法律責任設立新的先例，同時亦向廣告主發出訊號——品牌安全評估需要考量平台治理架構，而不僅限於廣告素材的投放環境安全。

Court filings entered as evidence in March 2026 and reported by NPR reveal that TikTok employees raised multiple child safety concerns internally, with executives allegedly failing to act on them. The specific concerns documented in depositions include: minors appearing in sexual content available for purchase on the platform; minors exploiting loopholes to access age-restricted features; minors concealing their platform activity from parents; and user exposure to suicide-related content. A particularly notable internal decision documented in the filings: TikTok deliberately avoided conducting user-age surveys to prevent having to disclose the results to the Federal Trade Commission.

TikTok now faces hundreds of consolidated federal lawsuits alongside Meta, Google (YouTube), and Snap. The central allegations are that these platforms caused harm to minors and that the companies failed to disclose known risks. Cases have been consolidated for federal proceedings; TikTok has settled several individual cases before trial. Separately, a Los Angeles jury found that Meta and YouTube had deliberately designed their platforms to addict young users — a verdict that sets a legal context for the remaining TikTok cases.

In response to the document disclosures, a TikTok spokesperson stated that 'these citations and claims are clearly cherry-picked at the behest of trial lawyers,' and cited the company's investment of 'billions of dollars in Trust and Safety.' The depositions are part of formal legal proceedings; their evidentiary weight remains subject to court determination.

For the advertising industry, the case introduces a new dimension to brand safety assessment. The allegation that employee-raised safety warnings went unaddressed at the management level — if sustained in court — would establish precedent for platform liability that extends beyond content moderation outcomes to governance processes. Advertisers evaluating platform risk may need to look beyond ad placement environments to the internal decision-making structures that govern how platforms respond to known harms.
